assumptions.statement_zh: 组织方尚未发布官方总体边界与重点区域 polygon，本方案全部几何为 provisional 临时粗略约束，仅用于内容设计与机器校验；官方图形发布后必须整体复算。
assumptions.statement_en: No official boundary or key-area polygons are published yet; all geometry here is provisional and must be recomputed when official data arrives.

assumptions.statement_zh: 缝合界面涉及的绿地蓝线、文物保护与建设控制条件未知，本方案不给出任何具体数值结论，仅保留概念口径的示意。
assumptions.statement_en: Statutory protection and control conditions are unknown; this proposal keeps concept-level indications only.

assumptions.statement_zh: 跨线通行与环境数据仅作概念性匿名聚合引用，不替代官方统计，不涉及任何真实个体信息。
assumptions.statement_en: Crossing and environmental data are concept-level anonymized references only, not official statistics.

assumptions.statement_zh: 缝合桥庭、东西市集廊与缝合轴设施均为原创概念建议，模块化可逆，不构成建设承诺。
assumptions.statement_en: All node facilities are original reversible conceptual proposals, not construction commitments.

assumptions.statement_zh: 跨线通行感知与舒适度建议仅提供匿名聚合与人工复核兜底，不设个体识别采集，不设无法人工终止的自动决定。
assumptions.statement_en: Crossing sensing and comfort suggestions process anonymized aggregates only, with human review as backstop.

assumptions.statement_zh: 东西社区缝合节、桥下市集月与慢行探访日等均为建议性设计，不代表已确定的政府安排或投资承诺。
assumptions.statement_en: The event system and phasing are design suggestions, not confirmed government or investment commitments.

assumptions.statement_zh: 北纬社区、未来科学城、怀柔科学城、经开区和京津冀均为概念学习接口，不代表已确定合作或资源到位。
assumptions.statement_en: Beiwei, Future Science City, Huairou Science City, the BDA and Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei are concept learning interfaces, not confirmed cooperation or available resources.

assumptions.statement_zh: 隐私、保留、删除、申诉和影响评估均为拟议治理要求，真实数据试验前必须由专业团队和责任主体确认。
assumptions.statement_en: Privacy, retention, deletion, appeal and impact assessment are proposed governance requirements to be confirmed before real-data testing.
